name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Weed Slayer
source:
A story where a jammer gets thrown into the universe of plant people to serve as the hero that decides the fate of following traditional roots or burning it all up, leading herb society to a new and better tomorrow. The game also features a simple basic combat system and a special familiar treat for long-time visual novel fans.

[Edited from [url=https://globalgamejam.org/2023/games/time-i-got-reincarnated-weed-slayer-0]Global Game Jam[/url]]
translation:
一名游戏创作活动的参与者，被扔进了植物人构成的宇宙，成为决定世界命运的英雄：是追随传统的根系，还是将一切付之一炬，引领草本社会迈向更美好的明天？本作还包含简单的基础战斗系统，以及为资深视觉小说玩家准备的一份特别惊喜。

[根据[url=https://globalgamejam.org/2023/games/time-i-got-reincarnated-weed-slayer-0]Global Game Jam[/url]介绍编辑]
